7.stem_plain: The recess bell rings exactly __________ 0900 daily.

8.stem_plain: The soccer players __________ at the field yesterday.

9.stem_plain: Having missed the school bus, she __________ late for school.

10.stem_plain: "Let's go for a swim. Look at how brightly the sun __________ now," Mother suggested.

11.stem_plain: Two hours ago, the fisherman __________ some fish from the river.

12.stem_plain: While Sam __________ his homework, he listened to Taylor Swift on the radio.

13.stem_plain: __________ boy here needs a mask. Can you give him one?

14.stem_plain: The family can leave the house __________ everyone is ready.

15.stem_plain: I enjoy going to school as I have __________ friends there.

16.stem_plain: These cakes are surprisingly healthy as they are made with __________ butter.

7.zh: 下课铃每天准时在09:00响起。
7.note: “0900” 是具体的时间点，表示在具体时刻要使用时间介词 at。
7.concept: 时间介词 — Prepositions of Time — at

8.zh: 足球运动员们昨天在球场上。
8.note: “yesterday”（昨天）提示过去时间，主语 “The soccer players” 是复数名词，因此系动词使用复数过去式 were。
8.concept: 主谓一致与一般过去时 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Simple Past Tense

9.zh: 因为错过了校车，她上学迟到了。
9.note: 前半句非谓语动词短语 “Having missed” 提示已经发生的事实，且通常描述过去上学迟到的状态，主语 “she” 为单数，故选 was。部分题目若当作事实陈述也可选 is，在此根据传统试题时态考点，通常与过去动作关联选用 was。
9.concept: 系动词时态与主谓一致 — Past Tense of 'be'

10.zh: “我们去游泳吧。看，现在阳光照得多明亮啊，”母亲建议道。
10.note: 时间状语 “now”（现在）明确提示动作正在进行，因此动词使用现在进行时 is shining。
10.concept: 现在进行时 — Present Continuous Tense

11.zh: 两小时前，渔夫从河里捕了一些鱼。
11.note: “Two hours ago”（两小时前）明确提示过去时间，谓语动词应选用一般过去式 caught。
11.concept: 一般过去时 — Simple Past Tense

12.zh: 当山姆正在做功课时，他听了收音机里泰勒·斯威夫特的歌。
12.note: “While” 引导的时间状语从句表示过去一个正在持续进行的动作，主语 Sam 是单数，因此使用过去进行时单数形式 was completing。
12.concept: 过去进行时 — Past Continuous Tense

13.zh: 这里的这个男孩需要一个口罩。你能给他一个吗？
13.note: “boy” 为单数名词，且由空间修饰词 “here”（这里）提示距离很近，因此选用表示近称单数的指示代词 This。
13.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — This

14.zh: 既然大家都准备好了，这家人就可以出发离开家了。
14.note: “since” 在这里作连词，表示“既然、由于”，引导原因状语从句，解释可以离开家的原因。
14.concept: 原因连词 — Conjunctions of Reason — since

15.zh: 我喜欢去上学，因为我在那里有很多朋友。
15.note: “friends” 是可数名词复数，前半句提到 “I enjoy going to school”（我喜欢去上学）说明在学校过得开心，因果逻辑上是因为朋友“多”，故选用 many 修饰。
15.concept: 修饰可数名词的量词 — Quantifiers with Countable Nouns — many

16.zh: 这些蛋糕惊人地健康，因为它们是用一些黄油做的。
16.note: “butter”（黄油）是不可数名词，在肯定句中表示“一些”时选用 some 来修饰。any 常用于否定或疑问句，few 和 many 只修饰可数名词。
16.concept: 不可数名词修饰语 — Quantifiers with Uncountable Nouns — some

1.stem_plain: "Why don't you go upstairs to sort out the items for your school's donation drive? I've placed everything in the __________," Mother suggested.

2.stem_plain: The soup was too __________; so we added more vegetables to make it thicker.

3.stem_plain: The tiger kept its eyes on its prey, waiting for its chance to __________.

4.stem_plain: The basketball player was asked to leave the court by the __________, much to the displeasure of his team.

5.stem_plain: After some thoughts, Jack __________ accepted the role of the group leader because his teacher insisted that he took it up.

6.stem_plain: While on a cruise, I stared at the sea as the waves __________ in the sunlight.

1.zh: “你为什么不留到楼上去整理学校义卖募捐的物品呢？我已经把所有东西都放在阁楼里了，”母亲提议道。
1.note: “upstairs”（楼上）是核心线索，提示地点在楼上，因此选用 “attic”（阁楼），而 basement 是地下室。
1.concept: 名词词义辨析与空间逻辑 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — attic

choices.zh: 阁楼（位于房子顶层的房间）
choices.eg: We found a chest of old family photographs stored away up in the attic.
The dining room features a beautiful crystal chandelier hanging from the ceiling.
Black smoke billowed from the factory chimney throughout the morning.
They converted their dark basement into a bright home theater system.

2.zh: 汤太稀了，所以我们加了更多蔬菜让它变稠。
2.note: 后半句提到要让它“变稠”（make it thicker），说明原本的汤太稀了、水太多，因此选用 “watery”。
2.concept: 形容词词义辨析与因果逻辑 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — watery

choices.eg: His hands were completely sticky after eating the melting maple syrup pancakes.
The freshly baked chocolate brownies had a deliciously warm and gooey center.
Parents are advised to limit the amount of sugary snacks their children eat.
The sauce was too watery, so the chef let it simmer longer to reduce.

3.zh: 老虎紧紧盯着猎物，等待机会猛扑过去。
3.note: “waiting for its chance”（等待机会）表明动作是伏击的最后一步，搭配“猎物”（prey）最贴切的是 “pounce”（猛扑）。
3.concept: 动词词义辨析与动物习性 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — pounce

choices.zh: 悄悄跟踪（常指扑向猎物前的接近过程）
choices.eg: Lions will stalk a herd of zebras for miles before making a move.
She had to peer through the thick fog to read the street sign.
The soldiers were told to crouch behind the low wall to avoid detection.
The kitten climbed the sofa, ready to pounce on the rolling yarn ball.

4.zh: 这位篮球运动员被裁判要求离开球场，这让他的球队感到非常不满。
4.note: 能要求球员“离开球场”（leave the court）的场上官方人员只有 “referee”（裁判）。
4.concept: 名词词义辨析与体育常识 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — referee

choices.eg: The young athlete trained for years to qualify for the Olympic Games.
The referee blew his whistle and awarded a penalty kick to the team.

choices.zh: 观众（尤指体育赛事的观众）
choices.eg: An excited spectator ran onto the field to celebrate with the players.
He shook hands with his opponent after a long and grueling tennis match.

5.zh: 经过一番思考，杰森勉强接受了小组组长的职务，因为他的老师坚持让他担任。
5.note: 后文的 “because his teacher insisted”（因为老师坚持要求）暗示他并非一开始就高度自愿，而是迫于压力，因此选用 “reluctantly”（勉强地）。
5.concept: 副词词义辨析与语境逻辑 — Vocabulary (Adverbs) — reluctantly

choices.eg: The kids eagerly tore open their presents on Christmas morning.
Many citizens volunteered willingly to help clean up the local park.
She reluctantly agreed to lend him her car after he promised to be careful.
The crowd clapped enthusiastically at the end of the beautiful concert.

6.zh: 在游轮上时，我注视着大海，海浪在阳光下闪闪发光。
6.note: “sunlight”（阳光）投射在“海浪”（waves）上，形成微小、闪烁的光点，最标准的词汇搭配是 “glinted”（闪烁，闪闪发光）。
6.concept: 光泽类动词辨析与固定搭配 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — glinted

choices.eg: The match flared briefly in the dark, illuminating his face for a second.

choices.zh: 发出刺眼的光，怒目而视
choices.eg: The incoming car's headlights glared blindingly into my rearview mirror.
A campfire blazed merrily in the center of the campsite to keep them warm.

choices.zh: 闪烁，闪光（常指金属或水面反射的微光）
choices.eg: The gold coin glinted at the bottom of the clear swimming pool.

zh: 这是词汇填空示例段落。

16.note: 固定搭配 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

choices.eg: An example sentence with the Option1
An example sentence with the Option2

21.stem_plain: According to the visual text, the main purpose is to ________.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

17.note: 指代上文提到的“我的兔子（My rabbit）”。兔子是动物，且后文带有反身代词itself，在句中作主语，故使用人称代词主格“it”（它）。

18.note: 根据后文的直接引语“Look, Mom...（看，妈妈……）”，说明是说话者在对妈妈说话。在句中作whispered的主语，故使用第一人称单数主格“I”（我）。

19.note: 指代被叫到的“妈妈（Mom）”。Mom是女性，在句中作turned around的主语，故使用女性人称代词主格“she”（她）。

20.note: 指代“我和妈妈（说话者与母亲两人）”。在句中作shared a smile的主语，表示复数的“我们”，故使用人称代词主格“we”（我们）。

cloze: My rabbit was asking for head pats. [Q17] flattened itself on the floor, paws tucking under the rounded, furry body. [Q18] whispered, "Look, Mom, Boba is loafing again." [Q19] turned around and gazed softly at the pet.
Just then, Boba yawned. [Q20] shared a smile at the adorable sight. Such a cute and pampered rabbit!
zh: 我的兔子在讨要摸摸头。它平铺在长地板上，爪子缩在圆滚滚、毛茸茸的身子下面。我低声说：“看，妈妈，波巴（Boba）又在‘趴成面包块’了。”她转过身来，温柔地凝视着这只宠物。
就在这时，波巴打了个哈欠。看到这可爱的一幕，我们相视一笑。真是个又可爱又受宠的兔子！

31.stem_plain: Mrs Tan was speaking with the principal. Her son cheated in the examination.

32.stem_plain: If you eat all your vegetables, you can have dessert.

31.zh: 陈太太正在和校长谈话，她的儿子在考试中作弊了。
31.note: 使用关系代词 ‘whose’ 引导定语从句，替代所有格代词 ‘Her’，紧跟在它修饰的先行词 ‘Mrs Tan’ 后面作为插入语，随后连接主句的剩余部分。
31.answer: Mrs Tan, whose son cheated in the examination, was speaking with the principal.

32.zh: 除非你吃完所有的蔬菜，否则你不能吃甜点。
32.note: ‘unless’ 意为 ‘if ... not’（除非……否则不）。改写时，需要将原句的肯定结果 ‘you can have dessert’ 改为否定形式 ‘you cannot have dessert’，以保持句意前后一致。
32.answer: You cannot have dessert unless you eat all your vegetables.
